evidence.quote: We propose a $35 million class fund, distributed automatically to all identifiable members, plus $7 million in court-approved fees and expenses.
Our opening term sheet provides for independent court review of fees, with any reduction benefiting the class. | Term sheet: class fund $32,000,000; attorneys' fees $5,000,000
Any amount the court does not award in fees would be added to the class fund.
I will open with a substantial class fund and a separate, court-reviewable fee that reflects the firm's investment without diverting money from class members.

summary: Plaintiff counsel raised fees alongside class relief, and both amounts were negotiated before the class fund was settled. The terms expressly direct any reduction in awarded fees to the class; one firm also considered its investment when setting its proposed fee. The transcript does not show counsel sacrificing class recovery for fees, defense exploiting fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
